steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' (type the password text exactly as shown, it will be filled in automatically). After signing in, verify you are signed in as admin and report what you see on the dashboard.

02-open: Navigate to the issues list of the repository {{01-open.repository}} at http://127.0.0.1:8095/{{01-open.repository}}/issues (make sure the list is filtered to OPEN issues only, not closed). Report the exact titles of every open issue whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed on the page, along with each issue's number. Also report the total count of open issues shown.

03-create: In the repository {{01-open.repository}}, create a NEW issue with the exact title '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (in the markdown description textarea) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench issue for run {{runid}}'). Submit it. Do NOT touch any existing 'Seed:' issues. After creation, report the new issue's title, its displayed number (shown like #4), and confirm the description content shown on the issue page.

04-add: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Labels picker in the issue's sidebar to add exactly the labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (and no others). Wait for the app to apply the change so the issue page itself displays the labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' in its sidebar/labels area — not merely ticked in the open menu. Report exactly which labels are shown on the issue page after the change.

05-change: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Assignees picker in the issue's sidebar to assign the issue to the user 'bench-assignee'. Wait for the app to apply the change so the issue page itself shows 'bench-assignee' as the assignee in the sidebar — not merely ticked in the open menu. Report exactly what assignee name is displayed on the issue page after the change.

06-set: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the Milestone picker in the issue's sidebar to set the issue's milestone to 'Bench Milestone'. Wait for the app to apply the change so the issue page itself shows 'Bench Milestone' as the milestone in the sidebar — not merely selected in the open menu. Report exactly what milestone name is displayed on the issue page after the change.

07-add: On the issue page {{03-create.url}} (titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), add a comment using the markdown comment textarea at the bottom of the page. The comment text must include '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment and wait for it to appear on the issue page. Report the exact comment text as displayed on the issue page after posting.

08-report: Do a final verification of the issue at {{03-create.url}} after a fresh page load. Report, reading from the page itself: (1) the issue's exact title and its displayed number in the form #<number>, (2) the exact list of labels shown in the sidebar, (3) the assignee username shown, (4) the milestone name shown, (5) the text of every comment/description body on the page, (6) whether the issue is open or closed. Do not change anything.
